mechanism: Moxifloxacin (fluoroquinolone) combined with phenelzine (MAOI) increases risk of serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis due to increased noradrenergic and serotonergic activity, with fluoroquinolones having reported MAOI-like properties.
action: Avoid this combination; if moxifloxacin is necessary, use alternative antibiotic class and monitor closely for hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome symptoms including agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, and hypertension.
